notes.title: Next Update Plan (Ver 2.0) - Voice Addition
notes.notes:
Next Update Plan (Ver 2.0) - Voice Addition

We are currently preparing the voice-over.

In Version 2.0, we will add voice-overs!

It is scheduled to be released in early August, so please stay tuned.

Note: The voice-over will be in Japanese only. There will be no English or Chinese voice-over.

notes.title: Version Upgrade 1.05
notes.notes:
- Changed "Doors," "Jails," "ATK/MAT/INT Traps," and "Opened Treasure Chests" to not require selection display when sufficient ability values are present.
- Changed "Iron," "Gold Bars," and "Mithril" to not require selection display when sufficient ability values are present.
- Added a feature to toggle Bingo animation between Normal and Simple modes.
- Changed Bingo prizes to a selection system.
- Modified the display of Special Tickets to always show in the bottom left during exploration.
- Recalibrated dungeon colors.
- Changed the clock on the Rest Map to prohibited use.
- Fixed a bug where obstacles in the Dark Church could be passed through.

notes.title: Bug Fixes Version 1.04
notes.notes:
- Adjusted an issue where the ATK/MAT/INT trap displays in red even if the HP is sufficiently high.
- Corrected the typo for "STOP" in the timing game.
- Fixed a bug where, after selecting Return and then canceling, Option 1 would always be selected on the next action.
- Changed the description of the shop treasure chest contents from "Appearance Count" to "Number of Contents."
- Fixed an issue where the product level display disappears after talking to the request in the bottom right of the shop and then canceling.
- Added an ON/OFF feature for animations in the replay scenes.
- Adjusted the items appearing in treasure chests.
- Changed the initial MP value at the start of the adventure from 0 to the maximum MP value.
- Reduced the screen freeze time on WIN display by more than half.
- Modified some dungeon colors to reduce eye strain from prolonged play as the dungeon appeared too red overall.
- Fixed a bug where, after collecting all BINGO balls, obtaining BINGO balls would convert them to marbles, but the marbles were not increasing.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
■Major Bugs

・Fixed a bug where MP would stop working when using a cake.
 Note: Save data affected by this bug in the past will be restored to normal when starting exploration.

■Other Fixes

・Fixed a bug where the swimsuit and maid outfits were reversed when the princess knight's HP was at 50%.
・Adjusted the timing input so that holding down the mouse click for fast-forwarding does not increase the speed of timing inputs.
・Fixed an issue where the mimic defeat achievement was being counted upon losing to a mimic during the tutorial, so it no longer counts.
・Fixed a bug in the rest map where, after resuming from a save, moving up from a forced movement floor would cause the player to pass through the workbench.
・Fixed a bug where the player could perform actions despite having low lewdness when the success rate was 100%.
